frame_metric: median across K1/K2/K3 for each statistic
subject_metric: median across all formal frames of that subject
subject_equal_overall: arithmetic mean of the five per-subject values
camera_metric: per subject median across frames, then equal-weight arithmetic mean across subjects
p95_gate: subject-equal Txyz P95 must be <= 1.05 times subject-equal Official P95
coverage: point-to-exact-triangle distance <=50 mm; same sampled observation points for Official/Txyz
low_error_frame: frame-level Official median across K1/K2/K3 <30 mm
meaningful_low_error_degradation: frame-level Txyz median minus Official median >5 mm
high_error_frame: frame-level Official median across K1/K2/K3 >=60 mm
primary_metric: observed person depth points to exact mesh triangle surface
rendered_depth_secondary: sensor depth and mask nearest-neighbor remapped from distorted color domain to pinhole K domain; mesh z-buffer rendered with the same pinhole K; paired common support also reported
